scientific_limitations: Geometric abstract graph critical group of the 28-bitangent/63-Steiner incidence graph for smooth nonhyperelliptic genus-three curves in characteristic different from two. Conditional stable-curve Néron interpretation requires regular split unit-thickness semistable smoothing with this exact dual graph. No Galois-module determination or degeneration of the original quartic is claimed. Historical priority is not exhaustively established; general quasi-symmetric-design Smith-form literature presents residual risk.
title: The integral critical group of the bitangent–Steiner incidence graph of a plane quartic
